findings.reason: the section exists to carry §50's unmet yield bar and no clause in it can detect that the bar is still unmet, so a node can close §51 with 143 reasoned failures and the yield clause is then carried by nothing.
findings.text: bullet 1 reads "every source in the rerun cohort reads back as produced, or failed with a reason written by this rerun", so a rerun producing zero new names passes, while §50 records that "Its unmet yield clause is carried by §51"

findings.reason: a tail run holding `-c 50` of its own satisfies the bullet as written at USD 51.49 total, so the per-run reading and the cumulative reading of the cap disagree and a worker cannot tell which one it must satisfy.
findings.text: the USD 50 ceiling is stated per run ("spend is at most USD 50 by the run's own id") while the cohort now takes two runs and the first has already spent USD 1.4855 of it, and `sib-second-pass-tail` says only "under the remaining cap"

findings.reason: a zero with no before-run count and no demonstrated positive cannot be told from a predicate that saw no exports, so the section's only name-independent measure is unfalsifiable.
findings.text: bullet 3 reads "the export gate's blocking set is 0 after the rerun, read with the gate's own predicate" and drops the control §50 carried for the same clause ("This is controlled by the before-run count of sourceless live drafts, which must not rise")

findings.reason: that node has already landed with its own gate and recorded control, so the wording is loose without changing what a worker would be dispatched to do.
findings.text: bullet 2 applies "each defect node's regression test fails on main and passes at its head" to the three test-only repairs, and for `sib-test-guards-bite` the defect is that five assertions stayed green through the regression they name, so there is no test that fails on main for that node to turn green

findings.reason: a coordinator dispatching from §51 can reset and rerun the 143 sources a second time, re-spending and re-disturbing the states the tail node's 41/19 split is defined against.
findings.text: §51 lists `sib-second-pass` as work to do ("a signed reset of the 143 sources … then a scoped `sn run -c 50`") in the same list that records that pass's outcome (job 1308283, 83 name-bound, 41 failed, 19 unreached) and creates `sib-second-pass-tail` precisely because it is spent, and the same node ids are declared again in §50
